title: BEN and Accelevate Solutions Launch AI-Powered Transportation Media Network
summary: BEN’s commercial-ready AI solutions deliver human-like responses using natural language, combined with the ability to remember customer details and problem solve in real-time on mobile devices, computers and stand-alone kiosks.
body_markdown:
**About Brand Engagement Network, Inc.**
Brand Engagement Network, Inc. ("BEN") builds secure, enterprise-grade artificial intelligence for the engagement layer of AI — where human intent is transformed into intelligent interactions, automated workflows, and real-world outcomes. Powered by BEN's proprietary Engagement Language Model (ELM™), BEN's technology enables conversational AI interactions that connect human intent to organizational data, workflows, and real-world outcomes. BEN's AI operates within secure closed-loop environments using approved organizational data and built-in governance and compliance controls. Trusted by organizations operating in regulated and high-impact industries, BEN helps bring AI into real operational settings where engagement drives outcomes and accountability matters.


For more information, visit[www.brandengagementnetwork.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4731126-1&h=1139732295&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.brandengagementnetwork.com%2F&a=www.brandengagementnetwork.com) .
